scale.zh: 观察示意 · 大小与距离分别缩放
scale.en: Illustration · sizes and distances scaled separately

localScale.zh: 固定观察区域 · 局部细节为示意
localScale.en: Fixed observation region · illustrative local detail

sectionScale.zh: 内部重建 · 层厚与颜色经调整 · 运动加速
sectionScale.en: Interior reconstruction · adjusted thicknesses and colors · accelerated motion

descentScale.zh: 虚拟观察路线 · 不是自由落体或可生存飞行
descentScale.en: Virtual observation path · not free fall or survivable flight

sunScale.zh: 太阳活动示意 · 颜色、尺度与时间经过调整
sunScale.en: Solar activity illustration · colors, scales and timing adjusted

gesture.zh: 拖动转动视角，滚轮缩放。画面获得焦点后可用方向键和加减键。
gesture.en: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. Focus the canvas for arrow keys and +/−.

travelHint.zh: 拖动进度条，可以停在任意高度。下降和现象动态可以分别暂停。
travelHint.en: Scrub to any height. Descent and activity can be paused independently.

sectionHint.zh: 点选一层，或拖动滑块走向中心。虚线提示候选分区。
sectionHint.en: Select a layer or scrub toward the center. Dashed lines mark uncertain regions.

none.zh: 这颗行星没有天然卫星。
none.en: This planet has no natural moons.

moonIntro.zh: 卫星绕行星运行，也和行星一起绕太阳。选择下方成员，比一比绕行的快慢。
moonIntro.en: Moons orbit planets and accompany them around the Sun. Select members below and compare their orbital motion.

selected.zh: 这里展示代表卫星，不是完整目录。环由许多颗粒组成，和一颗颗卫星不同。
selected.en: Selected moons are shown, not a complete catalog. Rings are made of many particles, unlike individual moons.

phases.zh: 继续探索：月亮为什么有圆有缺 →
phases.en: Explore further: why the Moon has phases →

uncertain.zh: 候选解释 · 仍在研究

sunHint.zh: 观察颗粒状亮斑、较暗黑子和边缘弧形日珥。可以暂停动态慢慢找。
sunHint.en: Look for bright granules, darker sunspots and arched prominences at the limb. Pause activity to inspect them.

siteModel.zh: 区域重建 · 地形高度与细节为示意
siteModel.en: Regional reconstruction · relief and details are illustrative

flowModel.zh: 材料运动重建 · 时间加速，纹理不是实测流场
flowModel.en: Reconstructed material motion · accelerated time, textures are not measured flow fields

atmosphereModel.zh: 固定观察区域 · 云层与流动为机制示意
atmosphereModel.en: Fixed observation region · clouds and flow are illustrative
